source.method: Decoded public Nuxt payload, cross-checked against rendered reward tiles and page requirements.
notes: Original provider fields and game item IDs are preserved under battlePass.
Tile id, slot, displayName, totalDocumentCost and page unlockRequirement are locally derived fields, not upstream IDs.
Tile IDs identify this snapshot by season/page/slot; reconcile future source reordering before reusing saved selections.
Images are remote source URLs, not downloaded assets. Nested rewards share the tile image; individual bundle images are not supplied.
An absent reward quantity is unspecified by the source, not an assumed quantity of one.
A tile is purchased once and counts once toward page progress, including the six-offer bundle on page 12.

rules.pageUnlockSemantics: Claim the required number of tiles on the immediately previous page; pages open sequentially.
rules.traderRewards: Unlock offers for purchase; the listed items are not directly granted.
rules.dailyLimitNote: The limit is shared: 10 documents collected in PvE leave 15 in the seasonal mode on the same day.
rules.costSemantics: Each tile cost maps document keys to required quantities. All entries are required together. totalDocumentCost sums quantities without exchange conversions.
